title.narrative: Environmentally sound management and disposal of polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB) - containing equipment and disposal of DDT wastes, and upgrade of technical expertise in Guatemala

description.narrative: To enhance inclusive and sustainable industrial development through strengthening of national capacities for the environmentally sound management of POPs, including disposal of 15 tons of DDT and up to 400 tons of PCBs and related waste, and reduction/elimination of PCB releases from serviced equipment at workshops and interim locations to protect human health and the environment
